screens.name: Игровой HUD
screens.spec: Active gameplay screen: overhead 2D pixel survivor exploring a ruined village with grass and infected in the distance. Show readable health, hunger, thirst, stamina, selected weapon/ammo, six quick slots, small minimap, compact six-player co-op status. Gameplay remains at least 75% unobstructed. No touch controls.

screens.name: Инвентарь
screens.spec: Inventory screen over dimmed overhead gameplay. Show a pixel survivor paper doll with separate backpack, helmet, vest, gloves, boots equipment slots; backpack storage grid holding food, bandage, water flask, ammunition, resources; item detail panel for a bandage, weight/capacity and quick slots. Clear visual hierarchy.

screens.name: Крафт и строительство
screens.spec: Crafting and base building screen over dimmed gameplay. Clear category navigation for survival, medicine, tools, construction. Select bandage recipe, show cloth ingredient counts 3/2, craft button, recipe cards including barricade and campfire, one locked advanced recipe with manual icon. This is a visual proposal, not fixed gameplay rules.

screens.name: Карта
screens.spec: World map screen of a large forested region with villages, a ruined city, roads, lake and rivers, discovered colored areas and fog of war. Six distinct co-op player markers, shelter marker, personal waypoint, corpse retrieval marker, compact legend and zoom controls. Overhead pixel geographic map, not isometric, not satellite.

screens.name: Выбор персонажа
screens.spec: Character selection screen for six original young adult male survivors. Names exactly Глеб, Роман, Мирон, Егор, Тимур, Макар. Six compact portrait selectors and a large crisp full-body pixel survivor preview WITHOUT backpack or held weapon. Appearance panel and short visual placeholders for traits, confirm button. Not photorealistic portraits, not franchise characters.

screens.name: Лобби кооператива
screens.spec: Co-op lobby screen for 2–6 players. Six slots, four occupied by pixel survivor portraits and two empty; ready state per player, invite button, room name, private-room indicator, compact host world settings such as world seed and weather, chat area and start button. No browser chrome, no mobile controls.

styles.name: Полевой
styles.spec: Minimal field interface: charcoal translucent panels, muted olive accent, warm off-white typography, small square pixel icons, hairline pixel borders, compact anchored composition, maximum breathing room. Practical restrained military-survival equipment aesthetic.

styles.name: Бумажный
styles.spec: Scavenged field journal interface: dirty warm ivory paper panels, faded moss green canvas and rusty ochre accents, subtle taped corners, ink pixel icons and stamped headings. Tactile but still clean readable pixel game UI; no busy decoration. Distinct journal-style layout.

styles.name: Контрастный
styles.spec: Bold accessible dark interface: opaque blue-charcoal blocks, amber highlights, restrained desaturated teal secondary accent, thick crisp pixel borders, large clear pixel icons, strong grouped hierarchy and generous item spacing. Distinct clean structured layout.

Create ONE polished landscape 16:9 desktop game screen mockup, edge-to-edge screenshot, for an original cooperative top-down pixel-art fungal apocalypse survival game. Screen: Игровой HUD.
